Subject: Rescheduling: NovaPulse technical deep-dive — final short options

Hi Sam,

Thanks again for the discovery this morning — really productive. I noticed the follow-up technical deep-dive was still on the calendar for 11:00 but looks like something came up on your side. No problem. To keep momentum, our engineering lead has two short windows we can hold for a focused 15-minute runthrough (integration + KV cache behavior + inference latency expectations):

• Slot A — Tue 30 Nov, 11:00–11:15 AM ET
• Slot B — Wed 1 Dec, 09:30–09:45 AM ET

Both slots are tight by design to cover the key integration points only. Please click one of these to lock it in: https://redwood.app/schedule/confirm?slot=1 (Slot A) or reply with the exact slot label. If we don't get a confirmation within 24 hours we'll release the seat and offer the next available windows.

Attached: nova-demo-agenda.pdf (short agenda)

Goal for the 15m: confirm data paths, auth flow, and initial perf expectations so your ops team can evaluate the Dedicated/Private options quickly.

If you want a longer session we can expand but need a firm yes for an extended slot.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0102

Jasmine —

Sorry about the scramble this morning, I got pulled into an exec incident and missed the deep-dive. We definitely want to keep moving. Short answers to the things you flagged during discovery:

• We will likely go with a hybrid onboarding (initially hosted, then Dedicated for steady-state).
• Main integration work will be API auth + prefix caching for similar prompts.
• Compliance team needs to see evidence of audit logs (SOC2 scope) — I can share the contact.

I can do Slot A (Tue 30 Nov 11:00 ET) but have a hard handoff at 11:15 — 15m should be fine if your engineering lead can be tight. If that slot fell through on your side, please hold my name and we'll confirm one of the two.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Patel
